label: Dependency licenses (Trivy)
description: Reads the licenses of the project's dependencies with trivy fs --scanners license. Comes in by evidence: only when a dependency manifest or lockfile exists (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, a .csproj...); runs only where licenses is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Runs in the security-scanners image that jgates tools prepare pins; without it the check is reported as not available here, never passed.
